title: Featured project
name: Nutin
summary: A minimal TypeScript frontend framework: DOM-based components and views, a router and an event bus, with no runtime dependency. It powers this portfolio, its own website and my other frontend projects.
highlight-1: Explicit, event-driven updates: no virtual DOM, no hidden change detection.
highlight-2: CLI, build pipeline, generators and test runner included.
highlight-3: Published on npm, documented on nutin.org.
